title: Your profile
lead: How your neighbours see you, which district is yours and how your account is protected.

profile.lead: This is all other residents see about you: in problem reports and in the menu.
profile.public: Only your avatar and nickname are public
profile.uploadHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MB. Location tags and camera data are removed right on your phone.

reports.lead: Problems you've reported: where they stand now and how many neighbours confirmed them.
reports.emptyTitle: You haven't reported any problems yet
reports.emptyText: Spotted a pothole, a dark yard or rubbish? Put a point on the map — your neighbours will confirm it, and here you'll watch the problem move towards “resolved”.

district.lead: The map opens on it first. Nobody else sees it.

security.lead: The password changes immediately. Your other devices will need to sign in again.
security.same: The new password is the same as the current one

account.lead: Language, theme, graphics, signing out and deleting your account.
account.languageText: Russian or English. Your choice is remembered in this browser.
account.themeText: Dark is a forest night, light is the city by day. Your choice is remembered in this browser.
account.graphicsText: Auto switches to light graphics instead of 3D scenes on a slow connection or a weak device. The choice is saved in this browser.
account.logoutText: On this device. Your marks and reports will stay.
account.deleteText: Permanently: your profile and sign-in. Your mood marks stay in the district statistics, no longer linked to you.
account.confirmText: This can't be undone. Enter your password to confirm.
